QuestInfo.name: Zeno, the Formidable Enemy
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 51,268\nCan proceed to Exposing the Scheme quest\n
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2050001##k from #b#m221000000##k has requested your cooperation to save the world...
QuestInfo.1: #o6220001# is a new model from the Grays, smarter and sturdier than most. But the #o6220001# I saw was a little wonky...according to #p2050001# in #b#m221040100##k, they've been seen attacking their own allies! He wants you to find out more about the #o6220001# from #b#p2050002##k.
QuestInfo.2: When you inquired about #o6220001#, #p2050002# began sweating and feigned ignorance. Something's a little fishy...report to #b#p2050001##k in #b#m221000000##k.

0.0: The #p2050002#s vigilantly waiting to take over the world have added a new type of robotic ordnance. #r#o6220001##k. It's just as powerful and sturdy as a robot, but has the intelligence that rival that of Grays. Even the M-Forcers couldn't easily defeat Zeno.
0.1: But #m221000000# can't back down. A command has been given to protect the world against enemies no matter how powerful they may be. The problem lies somewhere else. #o6220001# has been acting rather strangely as of late... will you look into this?

yes.0: For some reason, the #o6220001# aliens are attacking everything, not just #m221000000#. I don't know if it's just a #o6220001# or two rebelling or if there's some internal conflict among the Grays, but I need to know. Gather some info from #b#p2050002##k in #b#m221040100##k.

no.0: Hmm... it seems you're not qualified for this job.

1.0: What is it? We, the Alien Grays, enjoy talking to humans, but we don't have time for a chat... What? You want to know about Zeno? Why are you so curious? Huh? Is there something going on with Zeno?
1.1: No... No way. Hahahaha. Of course there isn't anything going on. This human friend is so curious! I'm not in charge of Zeno so I don't know much. What's with the face? You don't believe me? If you don't have anything else to ask, get out of here!

npc.0: You haven't talk to an #bAlien Gray#k yet?
